fact: DGCI Instruction 25/2025 states that production, validation and issue of the NIF may be done only through the module in the DGCI's Kontaktu system, and bans issue through SIGEF.
The CFE page states that after commercial registration on the CFE platform the DGCI agent validates the data and the NIF is generated electronically and assigned to the company.
The CFE page states that the NIF is issued as part of company registration at the CFE, the data being sent automatically to the DGCI, so applicants need not go to the DGCI.
The Kontaktu portal reproduces DGCI Instruction 25/2025, which confines production, validation and issue of the NIF to the Kontaktu module and bans SIGEF for it.
